name: issue
description: Work a single GitHub issue end to end — fetch its full context, branch, and start. Use when Josh points at an issue and wants it worked: 'let's look at issue 43', 'work on #43', 'start 43', 'pick up foo/bar#43', 'what's next?', 'grab the next issue', 'let's fix that bug'. Also with no ref on 'let's get started' or 'what am I on?' — the ref resolves from the conversation or the current git branch. An issue with at least one open sub-issue is a parent → hand off to the `epic` skill ('close out the epic', 'work through all of #40's children').
